newsitem.title: USA: Sangstat to seek Cyclosporine approval.
newsitem.headline: Sangstat to seek Cyclosporine approval.

text.p: SangStat Medical Corp said it intends to file for U.S. marketing clearance of its formulation of the organ transplant drug Cyclosporine formulation by the end of the year.

Cyclosporine is an immunosuppressive drug that reduces the threat of rejection in transplants. Recently concluded pivotal trials showed SangStat's generic Cyclosporine to be bioequivalent to other branded forms now on the market.
The company also said on Wednesday that it reached an agreement with Eli Lilly and Co to manufacture the drug for the worldwide market.
SangStat, however, retains exclusive commercial rights to the drug worldwide.
The company said the finding of bioequivalence will enable it to seek approval with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration with an abbreviated antibiotic drug application (AADA).
